agent_priors_used: Long-horizon autonomous agents accumulate compounding errors via path dependence and self-generated subproblems; without freshness gating and calibrated UNKNOWN abstention, replay/RAG appears to work on short horizons but increases false accepts over 38-session/599-turn horizons — prior, not SPIDER evidence

Tool/API bypass is O(1) amortized vs O(MxN) browsing only if endpoint discovery is stable across deployments (OpenAPI spec coverage >=70% and routing template stability >=20%); otherwise compilation cost dominates browsing — prior informing Frontier scope gating

Parameter induction from few exemplars is brittle to noise-field leakage and identifier polysemy; field-path relevance filtering and constant-anchor checks mitigate but do not generalize across heterogeneous sites without diverse census — prior informing Graph durability vs transfer priority

Measurement degeneracy at ceiling (discrimination=1.0, body-distinct) or floor (PMI=0 at K=3 H=0) is not evidence of sensitivity; history-sufficient strata make conditional PMI=0 mathematically forced — prior informing Runtime gradient-seeking and Physics branching requirement
